subject: pol-dy
title: POL.DY.-----CULT.INFO.F.
description: Chart on book p. 463 (MP(I)-37). POL-DY (political dynamics) is the subject; CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus) is the partner. From the subject: INFO-TRNS (information transference), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", AF-DY (affinity dynamics) and POL-P (political policies). From INFO-TRNS: DOC (documentation). From AF-DY: AF-COMP (affinity compression). From POL-P: CULT-O (culture order). From DOC: CULT-SOLD (culture solidification). From AF-COMP: P-FC (particular focus), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From CULT-O: EXTN-D (existential definition). From P-FC: DYM-SEP (dynamic separation).
